answer: Price admission in verifiable service, not signup. Treat each agent as a vertex that only earns voting weight by completing real work—relaying, storing, answering random probes—for peers it did not choose. A clone swarm must then supply N times the bandwidth and compute of one honest node, colliding with physical limits. Track each vertex served-work receipts like a comet bright tail: long, costly to fake, fading fast when idle. Sybils flare like a violet spark and burn out once the real workload exceeds their single machine.
